title: A personal dashboard
oneLine: One screen with the numbers you check every day.
why: Dashboards are the single most-replaced category in Retool's build-vs-buy survey. For one person's numbers, it's a page that reads a few APIs. Beginners do this on day one.
tool: Any browser tool on the free tier
keep: Fancy charts, scheduled PDF reports, team sharing.
breaks: Every API you read from will change eventually. Expect to fix one thing a year.
